harnessFailures.detail: After host restart the old fixed IP timed out. Hyper-V VM name and existing MAC and strict stored SSH host key identified new address. Original 128 GiB instance recovered with byte-exact reviewed wrapper, only one 4 GiB VM running.
Builder and guest have no 7z executable. Initial read-only helper failed with FileNotFoundError; NSIS family verified by file(1) and marker without executing an unverified tool.

Rapid individual keys and one typeText attempt did not reliably send the complete search word. A replace-all acted on e and replaced four characters. The incorrect change was captured and reverted with ordinary GUI Undo before any file save.

Python 3.9 rejected Z and nanosecond fractional ISO timestamps during a read-only independent check. Two failures retained; UTC seconds and Decimal fractional parts were then compared without discarding precision, and all three actual checkpoints passed. Guest state and evidence bytes unchanged.
Initial helper used an absent market-launch-job filename. It failed before changing any output or task. Corrected to the existing market-gui-job reference and exact97-byte output verification passed.

Python 3.9 direct source parsing rejected the generated report script despite an independent UTF-8 decode succeeding. Explicit read_text(encoding=utf-8) plus compile/exec completed the same script; no public files had been written by the rejected parse.

sourceLicenseLimitation: Fixed manual and headers declare generic BSD license; referenced obsolete OSI URL could not be retrieved. No BSD-2-Clause or BSD-3-Clause claim is made.
